summary: Dump truck rolled down an embankment near Gross Reservoir Dam ~12:30 a.m.; overnight search with boats, dive team and MedEvac spotlight transitioned to recovery; sonar located the truck in up to 43 ft of water; rescue divers recovered the driver deceased from the cab Driver identified as 28-year-old Matthew Liu.
location: Gross Reservoir Dam area, Boulder County
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder Fire-Rescue; Boulder Emergency Squad; Colorado State Patrol; American Medical Response; Coal Creek Fire Protection District; Denver Water; Northern Colorado MedEvac; Boulder County Coroner's Office
notes: Incident date 2022-06-18 (Saturday per Mountain-Ear story, parent-opened). BCSO case 22-02829. Kiewit-Barnard Joint Venture also on scene.
